(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Disember 2015.

Larangan

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama, sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua, melainkan arah yang ditentukan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama,

mulai tarikh yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD) (CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR)

(NO. 2) ORDER 2015

WHEREAS in the Notice under Subsection 70(2), P.U. (B) 441 published in the Gazette

on 28 October 2015, notice was given of the proposal to make an order under

subsections 70(1) and (2) of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur

against the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of

the Act, the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the Director General for

Road Transport, and after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of

Road) (City of Kuala Lumpur) (No. 2) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 December 2015.

Prohibition

2. The driving of all vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule, as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than in the

direction specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, with effect from the date

specified in column (3) of the First Schedule is prohibited.
